title: Cheap mood improvements before luxury bedrooms
applies_when: Basic needs are met but colonists have avoidable mood penalties.
approach: Provide accessible recreation such as a horseshoe pin with clear playing space. A second copy of the same recreation type does not provide variety.
Give colonists time to use it. Check recreation need and boredom before spending labor on a larger recreation room.
Read individual thoughts: fix the actual recurring problem, such as lack of a place to eat, poor sleep or incompatible equipment, rather than treating every low mood as a request for decoration.
verify: Usable recreation cells, time available, actual thoughts and changes in needs.
reconsider: Pain, grief or an individual requirement is the main cause; furniture may not resolve it.
